phone.description: The saved card's number in digits, leading zeros dropped, 7 digits at least — with or without the country code

home_country_phone.description: The same number with the business's calling code in front (hub country_code), or `phone` again when the hub's country is unknown. A thread keyed by any other prefix is somebody else (whatsapp_inbox#167)

customer_id.description: The one customer on file carrying that number. Never blank
